Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

#include<vector>
#include<set>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int thirdMax(vector<int>& nums) {
        sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
        int p = 0; // 用指针p 指向发现的新值的index
        for(int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++)
        {
            if (nums[p] != nums[i])
            {
                p++;
                nums[p] = nums[i];
            } 
        }
        int len = p + 1; // 现在不含重复的数的子区间为 [0, p]
        if (p + 1 < 3) return nums[p];
        return nums[p - 2];
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> arr = {3, 2, 4, 10};
    auto res = sol.thirdMax(arr);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
